    • getAsset

      @Nullable public Asset getAsset(@NonNull String path)
      Performs a sequential search across selected asset packs for a specific path. Returns the asset reference on the first match, or null otherwise. Enables access to the "assets" directory.

      A valid path must:

      • use only forward slashes as separators, not backslashes
      • contain only lowercase letters a to z, digits 0 to 9, dash (-), dot (.), underscore (_) in each segment
      • not start with or end with a slash
      • not use single dot (.) or dotdot (..) as a path segment
      • not contain consecutive slashes (//)
      Parameters:
      path - the path of the asset to search
      Returns:
      a reference to the asset, or null if not found
